SPECIFICATION FOR 

TAPER MALE STUD TEE BODY (STUD BRANCH ) FOR 

OIL-HYDRAULIC COUPLINGS 

PART I MADE FROM FORGIN6S 



1. Scope — Specifies the dimensions, material and other requirements for taper male stud tee 
bodies ( stud branch) for use in oil-hydraulic systems. 

2. Dimensions — Shall be as given in Table 1.

IS : 9724 (Part I)- 1981 

3. Material — Steel conforming to Class 1 A of IS ; 1875-1978 'Specification for carbon steel billets, 
blooms, slabs and bars for forgings {fourth revision )' or any other steel as agreed to between the 
user and the manufacturer. 

4. Surface Protection — Taper male stud tee bodies shall be phosphated to Class A2 of IS : 3618- 
1966 'Specification for phosphate treatment of iron and steel for protection against corrosion', 
unless otherwise agreed to between the user and the manufacturer. 

5. General Requirements 

5.1 These taper male stud tee bodies are intended for assembly in accordance with Type A of 
IS : 9767-1981 'Specification for tee coupling assemblies for oil-hydraulic systems'. 

5.2 For details not covered in this standard, reference shall be made to IS : 8805 ( Part I )-1978 
'General requirements for ferrule type couplings used in oil-hydraulic systems : Part I General 1 . 

6. Designation — A taper male stud tee body of light series L for outside diameter of tube 6 mm 
and conforming to this standard shall be designated as: 

Stud Tee Body L6 IS : 9724 ( Part I ) 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard covers taper male stud tee bodies (stud branch) made from forgings only. 
The tee bodies made from bar stock are covered in IS : 9724 ( Part II )-1981 'Specification for taper 
male stud tee body ( stud branch ) for oil- hydraulic couplings: Part II Made from bar stock'. 

In the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from the following 
standards: 

BS 4368: Specification for carbon and stainless steel compression couplings for tubes: 
Part 1 : 1972 Heavy series ( metric ) 
Part 3 : 1974 Light series ( metric). British Standards Institution (BSi) 

DIN 3906: 1966 Non-soldered taper-bush type pipe unions; T used as an adaptor with 
taper thread on screwed-in end for use with union nut. Deutsches 
Institut fur Normung (DIN ).
